seen.body: Push: an item whose parent is mirrored becomes a sub-issue of the parent's issue (REST sub_issues, which takes the child's issue id, not number); a parent change moves it; a removed parent removes the relation. Pull: a sub-issue relation made on GitHub that the ledger does not hold is a divergence (field parent), never applied silently. Idempotent: the mirror record remembers the relation it last wrote. Epics/issues/tasks follow the ledger kinds; tasks stay ledger-only as today.
seen.title: Sub-issues: the ledger parent shows as GitHub's native sub-issue relation
